direct_relative_v4_local_monodromy_bound.pullbacks: f105^*Z and f81^*Z are finite etale H-torsors on D
direct_relative_v4_local_monodromy_bound.reason: A small loop around a ramification point of either f_i maps to a sufficiently small contractible loop around its image in the compact base C2; the unramified H-torsor has trivial local monodromy there. Algebraically, finite etale is preserved by base change.
direct_relative_v4_local_monodromy_bound.consequence: The relative-V4 etale torsor by itself cannot charge a local branch-cycle parity or support condition against R105 or R81. Its direct retained content is global H^1/fixed-plane data.

uniform_marked_pair_mass_replay.derivation: Group the exact EX1 48 exceptional pairings, in source pts order locked by EX1-05C, using the 48-row marked exceptional incidence table. The result exactly reproduces the Stage32 transvection pair masses.
uniform_marked_pair_mass_replay.uniform_odd_contact_parity: For every actual carrier and every ordered pair p, if its contact orders are m_{p,j}, then M_p=sum_j m_{p,j}; modulo two M_p equals the number n_p of odd m_{p,j}. Hence n_p mod2=M_p mod2 independently of the total Q=210+2r.

uniform_weierstrass_action.uniformity_reason: The common ramified double-cover identity is fixed group-quotient geometry, while the branch-point action modulo two depends only on the fixed pair masses modulo two; varying Q only changes how much even contact mass is traded against pairs of odd contacts.

uniform_Q602_residue_refinement.realizability_firewall: The 87 cells are only Q-state x mod-2 compatibility cells. They are not actual curves, correspondences, or geometric carriers.

decision.reopen_condition: For further residue pruning, supply a non-gauge invariant distinguishing the three W-lines, or a higher/independent geometric condition on effective Q602 correspondences. For Q-state pruning, couple r to ramification divisor support/parity rather than only to the uniform fixed pair-mass parity.

known_gauge_dedup.reason_not_selected_as_next_route: Existing Stage32 asset already proves this is gauge compression only; re-running it would not reduce the EX1 Q-state population.

next_route.selection_reason: 05O makes the mod-2 correspondence action uniform across Q, so it cannot distinguish r. The closest remaining discrete route that actually sees the moving ramification data is the 05H class R81-R105 ~ f105^*K_C2-f81^*K_C2, which is 2-divisible and may carry a spin/theta parity invariant depending on branch support.
